summary: parse_rfc3339_relaxed panics when checking for UTC if byte index 3 splits a UTF-8 character in the remaining input. The fix compares byte slices, allowing malformed suffixes to return a parse error. This commit adds the detecting input "2015-02-18T23:16:9.15øøø" to test_datetime_from_str. The proposed reversal restores only the original implementation line; no tests were run.
expected_failure: byte index 3 is not a char boundary
